candidates.notes: Use cache mounts only with package-manager-appropriate sharing semantics.

candidates.notes: Requires reproducible action identity; never treat remote-cache hits as valid without cache-equivalence witnesses.

candidates.notes: Source-available license is not treated as unconditional permissive OSS. Perform license/compliance review before adoption. Do not auto-enroll a commercial/free-tier service.
